_doc: The manifest Hardtech-CAD reads (libs:cad-core ModelManifest). One entry per model: id, name, library (boats | architecture), format (lower-case extension family), path (repo-relative, LFS), source, licence, size (bytes), sha256 (of the file at path). `view` is an optional derived, triangulated GLB of the same model for phones (path, size, sha256, tool); the original stays the source of truth. `conversion` says why a closed format has no view yet.

models.name: One Lilo, 36 m sailing yacht
models.source: Owner's own file (Google Drive, archive 36-meter-sailing-yacht-1.snapshot.9.zip, member OneLilo.igs)

view.tool: tools/brep2glb.mjs with occt-import-js 0.0.23 (LGPL-2.1), linear deflection 0.08 of the bounding box (254k triangles), merged by colour

models.name: Campidoglio, Musei Capitolini, Palazzo Senatorio, Roma
models.conversion: No open-source SKP reader exists and SketchUp does not run on the Linux CI. Pending: export to GLB (and IFC) with SketchUp's own exporter (SketchUp Free or Pro), then add it here as `view`.

models.name: House Boat, two-deck pontoon houseboat
models.source: Owner's own file (archive boat-house-3.zip, member House Boat.obj, written by assimp 5.2; no .mtl shipped, colours from the material names in boats/obj/house-boat.colours.json)

view.tool: tools/obj2glb.mjs (pure Node), scale 0.001 (millimetres to metres), one primitive per material

models.name: DJI S900, hex-rotor camera drone
models.source: Owner's own file (archive dji-s900-hex-rotor-drone.zip, member DJI S900 STEP File.STEP, STEP AP214 written by SolidWorks 2015)

view.tool: tools/brep2glb-parts.mjs (packer tools/tess.js = libs:cad-brep tess.js) with occt-import-js 0.0.23 (LGPL-2.1), linear deflection 0.02 of the bounding box, Y-up kept, ONE NODE PER SOLID (237 parts, named from the STEP product, own colour)
